title: Canonical Read Coils request
purpose: Cover a fully documented read operation with explicit starting-address and quantity fields using a minimal valid Modbus/TCP ADU.
expected_behavior: Server accepts the MBAP header, decodes function 0x01, interprets starting address 0x0000 and quantity 0x0001, and returns a normal Read Coils response or a protocol-level exception response if the addressed object is unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0x0006 matches unit id plus 5-byte PDU
Function 0x01 request includes Starting Address and Quantity of Coils as documented
All bytes kept in canonical Modbus/TCP field order
PK-only valid request with no malformed lengths or truncation
issue_safety_notes: No issue evidence is enabled. Seed is a safe, valid structural baseline and avoids malformed or historically colliding payload patterns.
